bugs.title: Lettres & Philo and Langues Étrangères streams have 0 working learning bundles (Mission introuvable)
stepsToReproduce: 1. Register a student with stream 'lettres_philo' or 'langues_etrangeres'.
2. Complete or skip diagnostic to access dashboard.
3. Click on any recommended mission or navigate directly to a mission URL (e.g. /mission/philo_3as_awraq_01).
bugs.expectedBehavior: Should load pedagogical mission bundle with lesson, worked example, practice test, and error repair guide.
bugs.actualBehavior: Displays error screen 'المهمة غير موجودة' (Mission introuvable) because getSkillLearningBundle returns null for all 23 skills.
bugs.likelyCause: src/domain/content/mappings.ts only defined bundles for sciences_exp (31 skills) and partial gestion_eco. Lettres and langues have no bundle packages.
bugs.recommendedFix: Author core learning bundle packages for literary streams in src/domain/content/ or provide graceful fallback explaining upcoming availability.

bugs.title: Remote Supabase production database missing tables from migrations 013 to 017
bugs.expectedBehavior: All migration tables exist in Supabase with RLS policies enabled.
bugs.actualBehavior: ERROR: Could not find the table in the schema cache. System silently falls back to ephemeral localStorage and in-memory arrays.
bugs.likelyCause: Migrations 013_bac_mastery_user_progress_persistence.sql through 017_add_wilaya_and_comment_moderation.sql were never applied to the remote Supabase database.
bugs.recommendedFix: Run database migrations 013 through 017 on remote Supabase using Supabase CLI or SQL Editor.

bugs.title: Gestion & Économie skill bundles contain synthetic mock MCQ options in production
stepsToReproduce: 1. Open any Gestion & Économie mission practice question.
2. Inspect the MCQ options rendered on screen.
bugs.expectedBehavior: Options contain realistic pedagogical distractors representing specific calculation or conceptual errors.
bugs.actualBehavior: Options literally say 'خيار بديل opt_b', 'خيار بديل opt_c', and retests literally say 'الإجابة الصحيحة' and 'إجابة خاطئة شائعة'.
bugs.likelyCause: src/domain/content/mappings.ts lines 1333-1340 and 1370-1375 generate fallback strings when packages lack explicit MCQ option text.
bugs.recommendedFix: Author explicit mathematical distractors with authentic values and errors in gestion-economie packages.

bugs.title: Edge Middleware only guards '/ops/:path*', leaving all student routes unguarded at Edge
stepsToReproduce: 2. Inspect config.matcher which is set to ['/ops/:path*'].
3. Unauthenticated HTTP requests to /dashboard, /mission, /exam, /account bypass Edge middleware completely.
bugs.expectedBehavior: Edge middleware intercepts protected student routes and immediately redirects unauthenticated requests to /auth/login before rendering.
bugs.actualBehavior: Edge allows request through; client loads full bundle, initializes React state, and only redirects after client-side hydration causes layout shift.
bugs.likelyCause: middleware.ts matcher was narrowly constrained to avoid breaking static assets but excluded student routes.
bugs.recommendedFix: Expand config.matcher to include protected student paths: ['/ops/:path*', '/dashboard/:path*', '/mission/:path*', '/exam/:path*', '/error-lab/:path*', '/account/:path*'].

bugs.title: Receipt upload generates duplicate payment orders in operations cockpit
stepsToReproduce: 1. Student navigates to /subscribe and selects Season Pass.
4. Two distinct orders appear for the same transaction.
bugs.expectedBehavior: Exactly one payment order is created with receipt attached.
bugs.actualBehavior: Two orders appear: one with client-generated ID 'ord_17...' from local durable cache, and one with Supabase UUID from database insert.
bugs.likelyCause: In src/lib/operations/payments.ts, createPaymentOrder writes to memory and durable storage with ID 'ord_17...', then inserts to Supabase which returns a UUID. The durable storage is not reconciled, so loadDurableOrders returns the old ID while dbOrders returns the UUID. Both have receipts so deduping does not suppress either.
bugs.recommendedFix: Use the Supabase generated UUID or pre-generate a single authoritative UUID on the server before writing to durable storage. Avoid multi-format IDs.

bugs.title: Orphaned 846-line legacy onboarding wizard (/onboarding) unreferenced in app
stepsToReproduce: 1. Navigate to https://.../onboarding directly in browser.
bugs.expectedBehavior: A single coherent onboarding pipeline exists.
bugs.actualBehavior: An outdated, unlinked 846-line component exists that duplicates functionality now handled by /auth/register and /profile/academic.
bugs.likelyCause: Early prototype was abandoned when 5-step registration was implemented, but file was never deleted or redirected.
bugs.recommendedFix: Replace /onboarding with a permanent 301 redirect to /auth/register or remove the dead code.

bugs.title: Lettres & Philo diagnostic pool contains only 3 questions
stepsToReproduce: 2. Observe question counter and test length.
bugs.expectedBehavior: Diagnostic pool contains at least 15 comprehensive questions covering key syllabus axes.
bugs.actualBehavior: Test ends after only 3 questions, providing statistically insignificant gap detection.
bugs.recommendedFix: Expand Lettres & Philo diagnostic pool to at least 15 curated questions.

bugs.title: Experience social sharing as dynamic image card is missing
stepsToReproduce: 2. Look for option to share as an image card to WhatsApp/Instagram.
bugs.expectedBehavior: Button generates a branded 1080x1350 image card containing student advice, grade, and BAC 2027 watermark.
bugs.actualBehavior: Only copies plain text link or invokes native navigator.share.
bugs.likelyCause: Canvas / SVG image generator feature was requested by user but never implemented in the frontend.
bugs.recommendedFix: Implement an HTML5 Canvas or SVG export modal creating a branded social share card.

bugs.title: Experiences bank link missing from mobile drawer navigation
bugs.expectedBehavior: 'تجارب البكالوريا' (Experiences) should appear in primary navigation.
bugs.actualBehavior: Link is missing from mobile menu, forcing users to discover it by manual URL or footer.
bugs.likelyCause: Header component mobile links array was not updated when /experiences was released.
bugs.recommendedFix: Add /experiences to mobile navigation menu in src/components/layout/Header.tsx.

bugs.title: Missing SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY causes backend admin calls to fall back to anon key
bugs.expectedBehavior: Privileged operator actions (audit log insertion, role checks) execute using service role credentials with administrative bypass.
bugs.actualBehavior: Server client falls back to anon key and is constrained by public RLS policies.
bugs.likelyCause: Service role key was not added to production environment variables.
bugs.recommendedFix: Add SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY to production deployment environment variables.

bugs.title: Duplicate landing page route at /landing causes SEO duplication with /
stepsToReproduce: 2. Observe identical or near-identical landing content.
bugs.actualBehavior: Two distinct URLs serve landing content without canonical link tags.
bugs.likelyCause: Variant created during landing page A/B testing and never cleaned up.

bugs.title: Comment author wilaya is not immutable once posted
stepsToReproduce: 1. Post a comment from a student profile in Wilaya 16 (Alger).
3. Prior comment wilaya changes retroactively or desyncs.
bugs.expectedBehavior: Comment stores snapshot of wilaya at time of comment creation.
bugs.actualBehavior: Relies on join or profile lookup rather than immutable snapshot column.
bugs.likelyCause: Migration 017 added wilaya_name column but fallback storage uses live user profile.
bugs.recommendedFix: Always snapshot wilaya_name and wilaya_code directly in comment record on creation.
